name: nutrition
description: Datenpaket für Ernährungsmediziner: Tagebuch, Tagesaggregate, Glukose, Körperzusammensetzung
description_en: Data package for nutrition: diary, daily aggregates, blood glucose, body composition

queries.nutrition_daily: SELECT date, kcal, fat_g, carbs_g, protein_g, meal_count, last_meal, source FROM nutrition_daily WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.nutrition_entries: SELECT ts, date, time_str, name, product_id, energy_kj, fat_g, carbs_g, protein_g, source FROM nutrition_entries WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.body_composition: SELECT date, weight_kg, bmi, body_fat_pct, muscle_pct, water_pct, visceral_fat, metabolic_age, source FROM body_composition WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.blood_glucose: SELECT ts, date, glucose_mmol, glucose_mgdl, meal_context, source FROM blood_glucose WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
